# CBSE OSM OSINT Investigation

> Passive OSINT investigation into Coempt EduTeck's OnMark evaluation platform and the CBSE Class 12 On-Screen Marking (OSM) controversy, May 2026.

## Overview

In May 2026, 17.8 lakh CBSE Class 12 students had their handwritten answer sheets graded on a single vendor's (Coempt EduTeck) OnMark platform. Independent security researchers disclosed critical vulnerabilities. This investigation documents technical evidence, procurement irregularities, corporate network analysis, and the broader exam-technology industry.

## Pages

- [index.html](index.html) — Homepage with investigation overview, timeline, and navigation to all sections

### Deep Dives
- [know-your-coempt.html](know-your-coempt.html) — Corporate network analysis: Chary family (26 years of education-tech companies), S. Sadagopan (academic advisor since 2008), Ventureast (VC firm via Elbit Medical Diagnostics investment)
- [know-your-examtech.html](know-your-examtech.html) — India's exam technology industry: the SSC-Eduquity parallel scam, why TCS keeps losing to small firms, NEP 2020 digital examination reform, NEET CBT transition

### Technical Evidence
- [annexure.html](annexure.html) — Full code evidence: OTP bypass in Selenium automation, automated canvas marking, Jenkins CI integration, 77 API endpoints extracted from Angular bundle, OCR/Gemini pipeline, forensic git timeline with SHAs
- [api-surface.html](api-surface.html) — Complete API endpoint inventory with vulnerability classification (V-01 IDOR, V-02 password-less reset, V-03 unauthenticated photos), authentication architecture analysis, 30+ subdomain inventory

### Context
- [impacted-entities.html](impacted-entities.html) — All stakeholders: CBSE, Coempt EduTeck, state boards on OnMark platform, security researchers (Nisarga Adhikary, Sarthak Sidhant), civil society (IFF), vendor employees identified via OSINT
- [terms-of-reference.html](terms-of-reference.html) — Formal investigation framework: 33 questions across procurement, security, data protection, and accountability. RTI templates included.

## Key Findings

1. **OTP bypass**: CBSE OSM portal's OTP is displayed client-side — the Selenium automation code clicks Login without reading any OTP value
2. **77 API endpoints** extracted from a single 1.7MB Angular production bundle archived via Wayback Machine
3. **30+ institutions** share the same OnMark infrastructure (confirmed via SSL certificate transparency logs)
4. **Tender manipulation**: CBSE removed blacklist and cooling-off period requirements before awarding the contract to Coempt
5. **Corporate network**: Coempt is controlled by the Chary family (11+ interlocking companies since 2000), with S. Sadagopan as strategic advisor since 2008 (confirmed on his own website)

## Methodology

Passive OSINT only — no active testing. Sources: GitHub API, CRT.sh (SSL certificate transparency), Wayback Machine, HTTP header analysis, MCA corporate records, media reports.

## Disclaimer

No API keys, passwords, or specific credentials are reproduced. No live evaluation systems were accessed. All code snippets are from public repositories, reproduced verbatim for evidentiary purposes (credential values redacted).
